question: Where can I find a café in the northwest direction from the View Lounge, San Francisco, CA within 90 kilometers?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois AS cafe WHERE cafe.amenity = 'cafe' AND cafe.addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND cafe.addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' AND ST_DWithin(cafe.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%View Lounge%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 90000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%View Lounge%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1), cafe.geometry )) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
